A LITTLE DIRECTION

What would you
like to tell us?

Report a website problem

A page that does not load, a button that is hard to use, or a result display that seems wrong.

Write this email

Suggest a content correction

A confusing explanation, a typo, an accessibility issue, or a factual detail that needs a closer look.

Write this email

Ask a privacy question

A question about browser storage, Analytics, sharing a result, or information sent in an earlier message.

Write this email

MAKE IT EASY TO UNDERSTAND

A page, a moment,
and a little context.

  • The page address, with any personal result scores after # removed.
  • What you were trying to do and what happened instead.
  • Your device and browser, if the issue involves layout or a button.
  • The exact text and a supporting source, if you are suggesting a correction.

A screenshot can help, but crop or hide information you do not want to share. Full quiz answers and complete result links are usually unnecessary for reporting a layout problem.

Email includes your sender address and anything you attach. Read the email section of our privacy notice for more context.
